test_healthcheck: test the admin healthcheck endpoint returns 200 status and 'ok' response text
run_poll_healthcheck: run the poll utility to check /admin/healthcheck endpoint with expected 200 status code
verify_admin_url: verify the ADMIN_URL configuration points to a reachable admin endpoint
assert_response_status: assert the response status code matches expected 200 for healthcheck
assert_response_body: assert the response body contains 'ok' string for healthcheck validation
